prompt:
Build a single-ventilator, dual-patient breathing system using Simulink and Simscape physical networks. A shared periodic pressure source and common inspiratory/expiratory path must split into two physically distinct patient branches. Each patient branch must include airway resistance, lung compliance, physical pressure and flow measurement, appropriate one-way breathing-flow behavior, and an independently commanded physical branch-flow control element. Read the scalar base-workspace variables target_tv1_initial_mL, target_tv1_final_mL, target_tv2_initial_mL, target_tv2_final_mL, target_step_time_s, patient1_resistance_cmH2O_per_Lps, patient2_resistance_cmH2O_per_Lps, patient1_compliance_L_per_cmH2O, patient2_compliance_L_per_cmH2O, respiratory_rate_bpm, peep_cmH2O, and max_inspiratory_pressure_cmH2O. Their nominal values are 450 mL, 450 mL, 400 mL, 400 mL, 10 s, 10 and 12 cmH2O/(L/s), 0.045 and 0.040 L/cmH2O, 15 breaths/min, 5 cmH2O, and 30 cmH2O. Their allowed ranges are 300-550 mL for every tidal-volume target, 8-12 s, 5-25 cmH2O/(L/s) for each airway resistance, 0.025-0.070 L/cmH2O for each compliance, 12-24 breaths/min, 5-10 cmH2O PEEP, and 22-35 cmH2O maximum inspiratory pressure. Only these declared public variables may be assumed to exist in the base workspace; all other parameters and initialization dependencies must be self-contained in the saved model. Use feedback from the physically measured patient breathing states to regulate each patient's breath-delivered tidal volume to its requested initial value and requested step to the final value, while respecting PEEP and the maximum inspiratory-pressure limit across the declared patient-mechanics range. Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries patient_pressure with two channels ordered as patient 1 and patient 2 airway pressure in cmH2O; patient_flow with the corresponding physical airway flows in L/s, positive into each patient; patient_volume with the corresponding physical lung volumes in mL; and branch_command with the two normalized physical branch-opening commands ordered as patient 1 and patient 2, where 0 is most closed and 1 is most open. Pressure, flow, and volume outputs must originate from the corresponding physical patient locations rather than from references or constructed answer waveforms. Work directly in cand_XMED03.slx and keep the latest usable state saved at that path.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMED03.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
